name: Vishgraz, the Doomhive
oracle_text:
Menace, toxic 1 (Players dealt combat damage by this creature also get a poison counter.)
When Vishgraz enters, create three 1/1 colorless Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens with toxic 1 and "This token can't block."
Vishgraz gets +1/+1 for each poison counter your opponents have.
blocked_sentences: Vishgraz gets +1/+1 for each poison counter your opponents have.

needs.what: a static (and effect) value leaf that sums the poison counters across a player spec, e.g. {"poison_of": "each_opponent"} returning the total of PlayerState.poison over every opponent, usable as a self-only buff's power and toughness
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The only poison leaf in static_value_keys is max_poison_of, which returns the most poison on ONE opponent (Corrupted's existential reading); 'for each poison counter your opponents have' is the total across all opponents, which differs in any pod with poison on two or more opponents. sum takes a list of fixed terms and cannot iterate players, and counters_on reads objects, not players.
